author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
## Summary

Remediates a **high severity** Dependabot alert (#227, [GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8](https://github.com/marcusrbrown/sparkle/security/dependabot/227)): `nanoid` versions `<3.3.17` allow custom generators to loop indefinitely when `size` is zero.

`nanoid` is a transitive dependency pulled in via `@react-navigation/core` (through `expo-router` in `apps/fro-jive`). No direct usage in Sparkle source.

## Changes

- Added a pnpm override in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: `nanoid@<3.3.17: ^3.3.17`
- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`; `nanoid` now resolves to `3.3.17` (patched) everywhere in the tree

## Verification

- `pnpm check` — clean (0 errors, pre-existing markdown warnings only)
- `pnpm check:monorepo` (manypkg) — valid
- `pnpm build` — all 10 Turborepo tasks succeed
